source: distilled from terraria_calamity_weapon_effects_ru_v2.docx; template names are original InfiniCrafter patterns, not copied Calamity code

thrown_simple.summary: One real projectile with rotation, short trail and small impact. Best for knives, darts, shards.
notes: Use 1 projectile sprite; movement and trail are code-side.

slash_holdout.summary: Held/swing-like blade: one logic projectile, visual slash arc, ghost blades and line collision.
notes: Animation is timer/curve/draw-layer, not a sheet of unique projectiles.

beam_slash.summary: Slash arc plus a visible beam/streak layer. Damage remains bounded through line collision / the core projectile.
notes: Use draw layers for the beam whenever possible; spawn child projectiles only for real gameplay effects.

beam_slash_burst.summary: Calamity-like composition: slash visual, beam/streak visual, and impact burst on hit/expire.
notes: Do not generate 15 frames; generate core sprite + impact prompt and let code draw rings/ghosts/trails.

impact_burst.summary: Projectile transitions into a short expanding burst on hit/kill: rings, dust, optional impact sprite.
notes: Large-looking explosion may use a modest hitbox plus additive-looking draw layers.

spawner_on_hit.summary: On hit, spawn a tiny timed controller / echo motes / mini-slashes around the target under strict caps.
notes: Use owner guard and low child cap; most visual copies should be draw-only.

laser_beam.summary: One hitscan-ish beam: direction, length, line collision, begin/middle/end or drawn line layers.
notes: Never chain hundreds of projectile segments; one projectile draws the beam.

orbiting_projectile.summary: Projectile circles/spirals and draws pseudo-satellites as ghost layers, not child spam.
notes: Use draw loop for decorative satellites.

field_trap.summary: Short-lived stationary field/rune/cloud with periodic local visual pulses and small debuffs.
notes: Field is a logic projectile; particles and rings are client-side draw/dust.
